'''Zentilo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zentilo was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 4.0, the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], as a Level 60 Modification Vendor on Carrick Station and a number of worlds.
